title: Canonical stage, cone and tail comparison maps
statement: For a diagram D:I→Over(S) of qcqs schemes, a qcqs cone c, Grothendieck abelian A, an A-valued sheaf F on S and q≥0, construct canonical maps from the hypercover cohomology at each stage to the limit vertex. On a single stage hypercover the corresponding short-complex map has homology equal to this map after colimit injection. Iterated tail pullbacks compare by fibre-product pasting and satisfy the analogous injection identity.

Detailed proof paragraph 2: finite skeleta and canonical section comparisons

proof.text: Use the inverse of inverse-image composition to identify pullback of each stage coefficient sheaf with the cone coefficient sheaf. Apply hypercover pullback with this coefficient map. Mapping the unit and the coefficient map to short complexes gives the single-hypercover comparison; functoriality of homology proves its injection formula. For a tail object j→i, base change the initial hypercover along D_j→D_i. The canonical pullback-pasting morphism refines its limit pullback from the initial limit pullback. Compose the cone comparison with this refinement. The finite-refinement colimit relation gives the tail injection formula.
